observations.utf8: feat: warn in dev on `{@html ...}` block hydration mismatch
fix: improve namespace inference when having `{@render}` and `{@html}` tags
fix: don't execute scripts inside `@html` when instantiated on the client
- [at-html](https://github.com/micha-lmxt/at-html) lets you use `{@html }` tags with slots in Svelte apps
The expression will be stringified and escaped to prevent code injections. If you want to render HTML, use the `{@html}` tag instead.
In Svelte, you do this with the special `{@html ...}` tag:

> **Warning!** Svelte doesn't perform any sanitization of the expression inside `{@html ...}` before it gets inserted into the DOM. In other words, if you use this feature it's **critical** that you manually escape HTML that comes from sources you don't trust, otherwise you risk exposing your users to XSS attacks.
- fix: use non-destructive hydration for all `@html` tags ([#8880](https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/8880))
- Fix hydration regression with `{@html}` and components in `<svelte:head>` ([#7941](https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/7941))

- Fix hydration with `{@html}` and components in `<svelte:head>` ([#4533](https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/issues/4533), [#6463](https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/issues/6463), [#7444](https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/issues/7444))
